result.title: Don't Lose the Future: Latent-Aware 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models
result.summary: World action models (WAMs) predict how a scene will evolve and condition their actions on this predicted future. Deploying them on a robot's onboard computer calls for 4-bit weights, activations and key-value caches (W4A4KV4). Existing 4-bit quantizers for WAMs preserve the generated action, and estimate sensitivity one denoising step at a time. However, they fail to preserve the fidelity of the predicted future: once the action pathway is protected, the remaining action error enters mostly through a degraded future that none of them deliberately protects. We propose LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework that preserves the predicted future where it is written, stored and read. Specifically, we introduce a reader metric, which measures future error by its effect on the action, and a read count, which weights each rounding error by the number of denoising steps that read it. Together they give the allocation of precision over activations and caches a closed-form solution. We further develop gaze-guided refinement, which gives the tokens the action attends to a second 4-bit pass in the denoising loop and in the cache. All weights stay at 4 bits, with no high-precision branch and no per-task recalibration. On the LIBERO-Plus benchmark, LAQ reaches 76.4% and 83.3% average success on Fast-WAM and Cosmos-Policy, within 1.2 percentage points of the 16-bit models and all above the baselines with 16-bit KV caches. It compresses the model by 3.8x, reduces the peak GPU memory of the whole policy by 2.3x, and runs 1.66x faster than the 16-bit model. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, it reaches 47.0% average success over three tasks, against 52.0% for the 16-bit model and 30.0% higher than QuaRot.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LAQ，面向世界动作模型（WAM）的 4-bit 权重量化框架，用衡量未来误差对动作影响的「reader metric」与按去噪步读取次数加权的「read count」闭式分配激活与 KV cache 精度，并对动作关注的 token 在去噪与缓存中做第二遍 4-bit 精修，以保住预测未来。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按下游读取次数与动作影响来分配表示精度的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态保真、信息坍缩诊断与视觉证据筛选提供核查线索；但对象是机器人策略量化，非 VLM 推理，联系需较多判断。
